intent: Implement an accessible keyboard-shortcuts help dialog in the responsive Next.js Dorii Atlas dock. Add a compact help trigger to the existing dock, open the dialog with the question-mark key only when focus is outside editable controls, close it with Escape, restore focus to the opener, preserve the existing visual system, and respect reduced-motion preferences.
steps: Inspect the Atlas dock, existing overlay patterns, tokens, keyboard handling, and tests before editing.
Implement the smallest reusable shortcuts-help surface that follows existing component boundaries.
Add a visible, keyboard-reachable trigger with an accessible name and stable test identifier.
Implement question-mark open, Escape close, focus restoration, and editable-control guards.
Use existing design tokens and reduced-motion behavior without adding a new dependency.
Add focused unit coverage when a separable keyboard-state helper is introduced.
Run the complete build and rendered Playwright contract and repair every failure.
